selection_policy: real upstream concurrency defects only; source and (if present) fixed revision must be verifiable; candidates are not re-labelled from synthetic models

candidates.language: C++ (std::mutex), ROS 2 RMW binding over Zenoh
candidates.defect: two-mutex ABBA: wait_set condition_mutex <-> subscription mutex_
candidates.fixed_note: issue closed with no linked PR/commit exposed; suggested fix is release-before-acquire
candidates.reason: explicit two std::mutex in opposite order; maps to CIR sync Mutex; deadlock_free + completion preserved

candidates.defect: cross-shard ABBA: read(shard A)->write(shard B) vs read(shard B)->write(shard A)
candidates.fixed_note: issue closed with no linked PR/commit exposed; suggested fix is drop the Ref before mutating
candidates.reason: faithful RwLock model is CIR-syntax valid but CIR v1 lowering marks RwLock unsupported; kept to document the boundary, not rewritten as Mutex

candidates.defect: reader holds multiple Refs while a writer mutates; deadlock after the 5.x parking_lot switch
candidates.fixed_ref: pull/202 (issue closed by PR #202; exact merge SHA not captured at retrieval)
candidates.reason: unbounded shard/hash structure and RwLock; no faithful bounded CIR model; RwLock unsupported in CIR v1

candidates.language: Rust standard library (OS SRWLOCK on Windows)
candidates.defect: RwLock can deadlock with read locks holding/waiting; OS lock-implementation bug
candidates.reason: single OS-level lock, not a program lock-order ABBA; RwLock unsupported in CIR v1; fix is in the platform lock, not application code

candidates.defect: permanent stall with cargo.buildScripts + proc-macro + custom targetDir; blocking cargo invocation, not a lock-order cycle
candidates.reason: not a two-lock order inversion; no fixed revision; not representable in CIR

candidates.defect: parking_lot Mutex allocates, so an allocator lock can re-enter the global allocator and deadlock
candidates.reason: allocator reentrancy, not a lock-order ABBA across threads; no lock pair to model

candidates.defect: Runtime::block_on never returns although the future completed
candidates.reason: async runtime wakeup bug, not a mutex lock-order inversion; not representable in CIR

summary.note: Only rmw-zenoh-998 is both a real two-mutex ABBA and supported by the current CIR (Mutex) subset. dashmap-369 is a faithful RwLock model kept as a documented support boundary. The other candidates are not lock-order inversions or not representable.
